title: Elephant & Goldfish Bifurcated Cognitive Context Architecture: Asymmetric Memory Partitioning, Zero-Context Subagents, and Hallucination Suppression
author: Jim Quinn, Elise Ewing, Dave Rensin (Google LLC, 2026; synthesized by Brain Harness)

claims.assertion: Unstructured conversational single-thread code generation leads to hallucination cascades and confirmation bias because the model validates its own faulty hypotheses; separating deep-context drafting (Elephant) from zero-context isolated subagent review (Goldfish) suppresses this bias.

A Goldfish subagent must run in a fresh, isolated context containing only the target document and referenced source code, with zero prior chat history; evaluating drafts within the parent conversational session is invalid under the Goldfish protocol.

Goldfish reviewers must be prompted with explicit negative constraints: strictly banning sycophancy ('no glazing', no empty compliments), banning polite apologies, and enforcing a critique-first mandate.
